string.name: desc
string.value: Teleport in the direction you want by becoming a beam of light. You will be invulnerable for a short time after teleporting. Also permanently increases Movement Speed and Jump.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon. Teleports a range of #x, #y. Become invulnerable to physical attacks for a short time after teleport.\n[Passive Effect : Increases Movement Speed by #psdSpeed, increases Jump by #psdJump]
